declaredIdentity: tenant/risk-methods/v5(tenant,risk-method:program); versionId derives current sequential number. Publish lacks stable request identity; exact retry with original expectedVersion conflicts instead of no-op.
invariant: The program method advances sequentially by expected published version and each immutable definition has complete valid 5x5 scales and permitted appetite.
boundaryRationale: Scales/appetite together define one method version and should remain atomic; historical versions can be immutable definition records read as values while narrow owner retains current version identity. No need split scale members.
identityReadingRule: selectedIdentitySummary and exact selectedCommandContracts define intended identity. baselineIdentityObservation/declaredIdentity retain older source observations only, including old replay defects; they are not target behavior or authorization to change an occupied key.

logicalIdentity.rule: CommandId binds one immutable authored intent to the exact owner identity and expected revision: an exact retry returns the original result, a changed intent under the same CommandId is refused

baselineIdentityObservation: tenant/risk-methods/v5(tenant,risk-method:program); versionId derives current sequential number. Publish lacks stable request identity; exact retry with original expectedVersion conflicts instead of no-op.
identityContractRule: Existing published owner identity/IdFor remains stable. Required typed creation/operation identity and tenant/program/source scope come from the selected signature/protocol references; no context.RequestId minting fallback or guessed new stream key.
selectedIdentityClarification: Existing tenant-scoped risk-method identity derived from ProgramId by the unchanged UUIDv5 algorithm. Selected CommandId identifies publication of one exact method/version intent.
selectedIdentitySummary: Existing tenant-scoped risk-method identity derived from ProgramId by the unchanged UUIDv5 algorithm. Selected CommandId identifies publication of one exact method/version intent.
selectedReplayRule: Current required authorization precedes replay; exact authorized retries resolve the original accepted result using the selected logical identity and immutable actor/intent/source binding. Fresh mutable feasibility, clock selection and body preparation cannot replace that original result. Expected revision is concurrency precondition, not a new identity.

productRules.rule: A risk method is versioned per program, uses a qualitative 5x5 kind with five-level likelihood and impact scales, and carries a nullable appetite threshold (1 to 25 residual score) and a one-year reassessment interval.

decides: A method is qualitative 5x5 with five-level likelihood and impact scales, a nullable appetite threshold when set between 1 and 25 residual score, and a P1Y reassessment interval.
